Bettina, I've saved the weekly digest job, but it won't reliably post on Monday yet. I replied in the thread on your message with the same caveats.

- **What it does:** every Monday at 08:00 it reads only #coastal-team and #coastal-random. It posts a "Coastal week ahead" digest covering the previous week plus open customer items. It leaves out finance figures such as discounts and rates.
- **Scheduler not running:** the gateway that fires scheduled jobs isn't running, so nothing will post until someone starts it.
- **Output is local-only:** I saved the job with output going to a local file rather than into #coastal-team. The job can't post to Slack on its own yet, so the digest may not appear in this channel even once the scheduler is running.
- **Timing mismatch:** the scheduler runs on UTC and shows the first run as Monday 26 Oct at 08:00 UTC. You asked for Monday 19 Oct at 08:00 Chicago time. Someone with admin access should check this before Monday.
